detailed_description:
The target video uses a stylized 3D CG animation aesthetic seamlessly integrated with a cinematic, eerie, and atmospheric environment.
[Shot 1] A medium-wide shot establishes <Subject 4>, the dimly lit, eerie hallway with greenish fluorescent ceiling lights, reflective tiled floors, and the open doorway on the right labeled "大体间". In the middle ground, <Subject 1>, holding her woven basket, and <Subject 3>, with her hands lightly resting at her sides, stand facing <Subject 2>, who holds her round wooden washbasin filled with folded fabrics. <Subject 1> (S1) speaks with a puzzled, cautious tone, <d>[Chinese] 这里的灯光好诡异，我们还是快点离开吧。</d> <Subject 2> (S2) looks around nervously, her eyes widening in apprehension as she clutches the wooden washbasin tighter and replies with a trembling voice, <d>[Chinese] 我总觉得……后面有什么东西在看着我们！</d> Suddenly, a flicker from the overhead fluorescent light casts a deep shadow behind them. <Subject 2> gasps, frantically drops the wooden washbasin onto the floor with fabrics spilling out, quickly spins around, and starts running away down the corridor toward the far window. The camera pans slightly right to follow the start of her panicked retreat.
[Shot 2] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a medium-long tracking shot from behind <Subject 2>, keeping her central in the frame as she sprints in panic along the tiled hallway of <Subject 4>. The camera trucks forward at fast speed, tracking behind her flowing red dress and trailing ribbon as she dashes past closed doors and beneath the flickering fluorescent tubes toward the end of the dark corridor, while <Subject 1> and <Subject 3> remain in the deep background looking after her in shock.

overall_soundscape:
A low fluorescent hum and an eerie, hollow building resonance reverberate through the hallway. The clatter and wooden thud of a washbasin dropping onto tiles echo sharply, followed by rapid, panicked footsteps receding down the corridor.

non_diegetic_music:
A subtle, low-frequency atmospheric drone layered with sparse, suspenseful metallic textures, slightly building in tension as the girl begins to run.
